stage_name: D3.5-A6 Phase 0-R1-R1 — Causal Budget Selection & Verdict Precedence Repair
stage_type: extremely narrow preregistration decision-contract repair; no Phase-1 implementation, no real treatment pools, no select_v2/reranker/scorer/model execution, no new scientific outcome

remaining_defects.description: the K2/K3 selector used SAFE_EFFECTIVE(K) = DELTA_K > 0 AND REGRESSION_K == 0 while mechanistic PASS additionally required a stable reserved-required-candidate witness, so a budget could be selected first and then fail the causal PASS gate even when another budget would satisfy the mechanistic causal criterion
stable pool-perturbation recovery without a reserved-required-candidate witness had no precise final verdict
MATERIAL_CONTROL_REGRESSION was not explicitly distinguished from FAIL-level structural safety invariant failures, and the FAIL trigger 'systematic control degradation' was ambiguous

CAUSAL_DELTA_contract.CAUSAL_DELTA_K: number of ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUPs that satisfy BOTH: (1) the group is STABLE_RETAINED under treatment K AND NOT STABLE_RETAINED under BASELINE; (2) the same group has STABLE_RESERVED_REQUIRED_WITNESS under treatment K
CAUSAL_DELTA_contract.equivalent_reading: stable incremental admission recovery with a stable actually-reserved required-candidate witness
CAUSAL_DELTA_contract.CAUSAL_DELTA_2: causal admission benefit of K2 (primary mechanistic benefit count)
CAUSAL_DELTA_contract.CAUSAL_DELTA_3: causal admission benefit of K3 (primary mechanistic benefit count)
CAUSAL_DELTA_contract.interpretation_boundary: DELTA_K = stable downstream recovery after admission-induced pool perturbation; CAUSAL_DELTA_K = stable downstream recovery directly witnessed by an actually reserved required bridge candidate; never conflated
CAUSAL_DELTA_contract.DELTA_K_retained: DELTA_2 / DELTA_3 remain frozen downstream-recovery diagnostics (stable pool-level admission perturbation benefit) and are never deleted

NONCAUSAL_STABLE_DELTA_contract.role: diagnostic only — stable improvement correlated with the admission-modified pool but not mechanistically carried by an actually reserved required candidate
NONCAUSAL_STABLE_DELTA_contract.prohibition: never used to claim direct bridge-admission recovery; no runtime effect

MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE_contract.superseded_rule: SAFE_EFFECTIVE(K) = DELTA_K > 0 AND REGRESSION_K == 0 (Phase0-R1) is insufficient for mechanistic budget selection; marked superseded for PASS selection and retained only as a broader diagnostic
MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE_contract.unsafe_budget_rule: if CAUSAL_DELTA_K > 0 but REGRESSION_K > 0 then MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE(K) = false; safety still precedes budget minimality

causal_budget_decision_rule.DEFAULT_BUDGET_PRINCIPLE: smallest sufficient causally witnessed safe budget — not the smallest budget and not the largest DELTA_K budget
hierarchy: if K2 is MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE and K3 is MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE: SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET = 3 if CAUSAL_DELTA_3 > CAUSAL_DELTA_2 else 2
else: no budget is selected as PASS
causal_budget_decision_rule.k3_beats_k2_only_on_causal_benefit: if both budgets are mechanistically safe, CAUSAL_DELTA_3 > CAUSAL_DELTA_2 selects K3, otherwise K2; a pure increase in DELTA_K, median rank, MRR-like diagnostics, or NONCAUSAL_STABLE_DELTA_K can never by itself justify K3

frozen_synthetic_edge_case.note: design-only synthetic example, not a real-case test
frozen_synthetic_edge_case.correct_decision: SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET = 2 because only K2 provides causally witnessed bridge-admission recovery

causal_budget_decision_rule.budget_identity_prohibition: the budget is never chosen from positive-case identity

material_regression_classification.classification: MATERIAL_CONTROL_REGRESSION IS A SCIENTIFIC BUDGET-SAFETY OUTCOME
material_regression_classification.is_not: by itself a FAIL-level structural invariant failure
material_regression_classification.handling: a treatment may produce material control regression while the experiment remains valid and interpretable; such a result is handled through REGRESSION_K, MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE, and PARTIAL / ADMISSION_RECOVERY_WITH_CONTROL_REGRESSION
material_regression_classification.rule_unchanged: BASELINE retention_count >= 2 AND treatment retention_count <= 1; REGRESSION_2 / REGRESSION_3 unchanged; no new numeric threshold

applies_to: post-rerank replay parity failure discovered after implementation freeze
fail_scope.systematic_control_degradation_resolutio: the Phase-0 'systematic control degradation' FAIL trigger is removed: it does NOT mean one or more preregistered MATERIAL_CONTROL_REGRESSION groups — those are scientific treatment outcomes handled by REGRESSION_K / MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE / PARTIAL logic; no new numeric 'systematic' threshold is invented in this stage

PARTIAL_POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_REC.use_when: there exists at least one budget K with DELTA_K > 0 AND REGRESSION_K == 0, BUT for every safe budget: CAUSAL_DELTA_K == 0
PARTIAL_POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_REC.interpretation: admission-modified rerank pools produced stable downstream recovery, but the experiment did not validate that an actually reserved required bridge candidate carried that recovery; scientifically stronger than no downstream recovery but weaker than mechanistic PASS

PARTIAL_ADMISSION_RECOVERY_WITH_CONTROL_.scope: exists K with DELTA_K > 0 AND for every budget with DELTA_K > 0: REGRESSION_K > 0 (stable recovery exists but no stable-recovery budget is safe); may include causal or noncausal recovery; no PASS budget exists

PARTIAL_ADMISSION_RECOVERY_NOT_STABLE_AC.scope: only when DELTA_2 = 0 AND DELTA_3 = 0 AND UNSTABLE_ADMISSION_RECOVERY exists (prevents overlap with stable pool-perturbation recovery)

PARTIAL_ADMISSION_DID_NOT_VALIDATE_DOWNS.scope: only when DELTA_2 = 0, DELTA_3 = 0, and no UNSTABLE_ADMISSION_RECOVERY (the true residual no-recovery class)

partial_verdict_contracts.POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_RECOVERY_di: the Phase0-R1 diagnostic is preserved with the added relationship: if DELTA_K > CAUSAL_DELTA_K, the difference corresponds to stable pool-level recovery not backed by a stable reserved-required-candidate witness; no runtime effect

verdict_precedence.note: replaces the Phase0-R1 6-level precedence; total and non-overlapping with no outcome-dependent label selection
levels: 2. FAIL / BOUNDED_ADMISSION_CONSTRUCTION_OR_AUTHORITY_FAILED (structural construction / authority / implementation invariant failure)
3. PASS / BOUNDED_RERANK_ADMISSION_VALIDATED_FOR_DEVELOPMENT if at least one MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE budget exists
4. PARTIAL / ADMISSION_RECOVERY_WITH_CONTROL_REGRESSION if stable DELTA_K > 0 exists but every stable-recovery budget is unsafe
5. PARTIAL / POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_RECOVERY_WITHOUT_RESERVED_WITNESS if at least one safe budget has DELTA_K > 0 but no safe budget has CAUSAL_DELTA_K > 0
6. PARTIAL / ADMISSION_RECOVERY_NOT_STABLE_ACROSS_RERANKER_REPETITIONS if DELTA_2 = DELTA_3 = 0 but UNSTABLE_ADMISSION_RECOVERY exists
verdict_precedence.safe_budget_meaning_in_precedence: a budget is safe in levels 4-5 when REGRESSION_K == 0

requires_all: at least one MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE budget exists
SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET chosen by the frozen causal-safe hierarchy
PASS_semantics.no_separate_witness_after_selection: the witness is already embedded in CAUSAL_DELTA_K

repair_A_unchanged: selector-visible text = full frozen selector-visible text (OPTION A)
populations_unchanged: safety population = all BASELINE_STABLE evaluator-required/control groups
broad_architecture_unchanged: MATERIAL_CONTROL_REGRESSION = BASELINE retention_count >= 2 AND treatment retention_count <= 1

synthetic_truth_table_checks.scope: static/synthetic decision-logic checks only; no real case data, no treatment pools, no model calls
cases: K2 causal-safe, K3 higher DELTA but noncausal -> PASS with SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET = 2
K2 unsafe, K3 causal-safe -> PASS with SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET = 3
both causal-safe, CAUSAL_DELTA equal -> PASS with SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET = 2
both causal-safe, K3 causal delta larger -> PASS with SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET = 3
stable safe DELTA but causal delta zero -> PARTIAL / POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_RECOVERY_WITHOUT_RESERVED_WITNESS
stable recovery only under unsafe arms -> PARTIAL / ADMISSION_RECOVERY_WITH_CONTROL_REGRESSION
no stable delta but isolated treatment recovery -> PARTIAL / ADMISSION_RECOVERY_NOT_STABLE_ACROSS_RERANKER_REPETITIONS
no stable or unstable recovery -> PARTIAL / ADMISSION_DID_NOT_VALIDATE_DOWNSTREAM_RECOVERY
structural invariant failure -> FAIL / BOUNDED_ADMISSION_CONSTRUCTION_OR_AUTHORITY_FAILED (precedence over all outcome classes)
synthetic_truth_table_checks.result: all cases map to exactly one final verdict and, where PASS is possible, exactly one selected admission budget
synthetic_truth_table_checks.executed_in: focused static verification (gitignored scratch tooling); no artifact writes

phase1_readiness.basis: the final preregistration now contains an unambiguous answer for every combination of DELTA_2/DELTA_3, CAUSAL_DELTA_2/CAUSAL_DELTA_3, REGRESSION_2/REGRESSION_3, unstable recovery present/absent, and structural invariant pass/fail: exactly one final verdict and, where PASS is possible, exactly one selected admission budget

decision_basis: the three remaining decision-contract defects are completely repaired: the witness is embedded in the budget-eligibility metric (CAUSAL_DELTA_K / MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE / causal-safe hierarchy), stable pool-perturbation recovery has its own PARTIAL class with exact use-when conditions, and MATERIAL_CONTROL_REGRESSION is explicitly a scientific budget-safety outcome with FAIL narrowed to structural/protocol invariant failures; the 7-level precedence is total and non-overlapping and every synthetic truth-table case maps to exactly one verdict
exact_next_stage: D3.5-A6 Phase 1 — Bounded Admission Prototype & Synthetic Construction Freeze (REAL_CASE_RERANKER_CALLS = 0; PHASE1_SELECT_V2_RUNS = 0; complete replay-surface materialization gate before implementation freeze)

artifact_change_policy.phase0_r1_artifacts: narrowly annotated only (superseded-rule notice; Repair A/C sections unchanged)
